مُصَلَّبٌ A garment, or piece of cloth, figured with the resemblance of the صَلِيب [or cross]: (S, M, TA:) or figured with a صَلِيب: (A, Msb:) or figured with the resemblances of صُلْبَان [or crosses]. (TA.) [See 2.] ―
-b2- And A camel marked with the brand called the صَلِيب; (M, A, TA;)as also ↓ مَصْلُوبٌ : fem. of the latter with ة, applied to a she-camel; (M, TA;) as of the former also, applied to camels. (TA.) ―
-b3- And An Abyssinian (حَبَشِىٌّ) marked with the figure of the صَلِيب [or cross] upon his face. (A, TA.) ＝
-A2- See also صُلَّبِىٌّ, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
